concept_statement: An album about a city drowning in quiet rebellion, told through the eyes of someone who keeps looking for warmth in cold, artificial light. Each track moves the listener one step closer to deciding whether connection is still possible.

tracks.title: Neon Rain
tracks.brief: Arriving in a city that never remembers your name.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Streetlights blink in a language I don't know
Every window's a screen with nowhere left to go
I keep walking through the same electric rain
Looking for a signal that still knows my name

[Chorus]
Hold on, hold on, the static's calling loud
Hold on, hold on, I'm just a shape in the crowd
But somewhere in the wires there's a light still on
Hold on, hold on, until the night is gone

[Verse 2]
Chrome and ash are falling where the old house stood
They said it's progress, said it's all for good
I saved a photograph before the walls came down
The only proof that I was ever in this town

[Bridge]
Maybe the wreckage is where the flowers grow
Maybe the static is the only truth I know

[Chorus]
Hold on, hold on, the static's calling loud
Hold on, hold on, I'm just a shape in the crowd
But somewhere in the wires there's a light still on
Hold on, hold on, until the night is gone

feedback_history.syllable_notes: Line 3 of verse 1 runs noticeably longer (14 syllables) than its neighbors (~9-10), breaking the scan.
feedback_history.rhyme_notes: Verse 2 drifts from the AABB pattern established in verse 1 -- the third line doesn't rhyme with the fourth.
feedback_history.flow_notes: The bridge is a touch too long for the requested tempo and slows momentum right before the final chorus.
feedback_history.revision_instructions: Trim verse 1 line 3 to roughly 9-10 syllables to match its neighbors. Fix the verse 2 rhyme so lines 3-4 rhyme, matching the AABB pattern from verse 1. Shorten the bridge by one line to keep momentum into the final chorus.
